text: The purpose of this report is to outline the proposed development and reporting timeline for the Mount Dennis Community for All Action Plan. The Mount Dennis area is set to become one of the most transit-connected neighbourhoods in Toronto. When the Eglinton Crosstown LRT is complete, Mount Dennis will be the western terminus station and a key interconnection point between the subway and commuter rail systems, providing access to the Kitchener GO Line and UP Express. Ultimately, the population of Mount Dennis is projected to triple in the next 20 years. In anticipation of this connectivity and resultant transit-oriented development interest, a significant amount of study work has been completed in the area over recent years.
